newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline pulls back slightly with crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline pulls back slightly with crude.

text.p: NWE gasoline was steady to slightly lower on Friday after Thursday's sharp rally and a moderate selloff in Brent crude, traders said.
Some traders questioned whether recent buying into the U.K. ahead of the government's budget on Nov 26 and active cargo business after the arbitrage opened would continue to support gasoline prices.
Some said the arb to the U.S. may be close to shut.
"Prices from a demand and supply perspective are far too high," said one trader, who conceded that gasoline would still be whipsawed by crude and gasoline futures.
He said Eurograde barges were heard but not confirmed traded at $225 and $232 fob, but prices were holding at $229/$231 fob ARA, down $1 from Thursday.
Regular unleaded barges were off $2 at $219/$221.
